fusions.name: Rendered Tallow
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Throws a gobbet of your own burning fat at the first enemy in its path for 8 damage and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Flare-Up
fusions.desc: Your fur flares up, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, knocking them back 2.5 tiles and setting them [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Singeing Pelt
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and sets them [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Kindled Temper
fusions.desc: When anything but fire hurts you, your physical damage rises 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
